title: Concatenating a reach and a halting run
statement: Let $A$ be a machine with memory, let $x$ be an input, and let $G$ be a predicate on configurations. If the machine reaches configuration $b$ from configuration $a$ in finitely many steps while $G$ holds at every configuration strictly before reaching $b$, and from $b$ it halts with result $r$ while $G$ holds at every configuration strictly before halting, then it halts with result $r$ from $a$, with $G$ holding at every configuration strictly before that halt.
hypotheses_covered: A finite run reaches $b$ from $a$ and satisfies $G$ at each earlier configuration
A run from $b$ halts with result $r$ and satisfies $G$ at each earlier configuration
